evidence_basis: hash-verified frozen candidate and observation ledgers
canonical events, relations, routes, projects, and treatment-component observations
review_method_attestation.candidate_review_grain: Each of the 46 manifest candidates was assessed exactly once.
review_method_attestation.observation_review_grain: Each of the 57 manifest observations was accounted exactly once: 46 through one candidate finding and 11 through the frozen preterminal partition.
review_method_attestation.positive_rule: Publication requires a retrospective or contemporaneously delivered event, exact source-proven route-by-treatment incidences, an exhaustive application set, and an explicit no-cross-product proof.
review_method_attestation.alias_rule: Duplicate alias requires exact coreference to a named durable frozen candidate target; a forecast may alias the realized rollout only when the source project, route, and launch identity are the same.
review_method_attestation.insufficiency_rule: Insufficient evidence retains the source facts and prohibits realization, route, treatment, or plural-by-plural inference.
review_method_attestation.outside_domain_rule: Outside-domain is used only for a source-proven real event that is not an operational route-by-treatment episode.
review_method_attestation.rejection_rule: Rejected requires affirmative source contradiction; absence, prospective language, or coarse timing is never rejection.

preterminal_observation_partition.hash_basis: SHA-256 of key-sorted compact JSON for the observations array, followed by one LF.

candidate_partition_verification.hash_basis: SHA-256 of the candidate-id-sorted array of {candidate_id,candidate_key,recommended_disposition,target_candidate_id,observation_event_record_ids}, serialized as key-sorted compact JSON followed by one LF.
candidate_partition_verification.candidate_arithmetic: 0 published + 31 duplicate_alias + 12 insufficient_evidence + 2 outside_domain + 0 rejected + 1 schema_blocked = 46 accounted candidates.
candidate_partition_verification.terminal_nonpublication_arithmetic: 31 duplicate_alias + 12 insufficient_evidence + 2 outside_domain + 0 rejected = 45 terminal nonpublication recommendations; 1 schema blocker remains quarantined.
candidate_partition_verification.observation_arithmetic: 46 candidate-bearing observations + 11 unsupported_record observations + 0 not_episode_evidence observations = 57 accounted observations.

schema_blockers.detail: The pinned retrospective Bx12 project-elements block proves one June 2008 Bx12 SBS rollout with curbside bus lanes, transit signal priority, off-board fare payment, and new bus shelters. Canonical rows exist for the first three treatments but not the source-stated new-bus-shelter treatment. Publishing only three would make the application set non-exhaustive, while inventing a treatment record is outside receipt authority.

review_notes: Clean independent review. Repeated project-launch observations resolve to durable frozen targets even when an earlier source used a forecast season; prospective treatment milestones remain terminally non-authorizing; study and feedback-portal starts are outside the operational domain; and one exact Bx12 package is quarantined because its fourth source-stated treatment lacks a canonical row.
